items.text: Look at the card first, then edit only the fields you want to change.
A What's new card on the scan screen, and the full version history in Settings.
Typing no longer rebuilds the contact file or the QR code.
The QR code stays black on white in every theme.
Settings are grouped, searchable, and use preset sheets.
Leaving an edit asks before your changes are dropped, and discarding a card can be undone.
Scan a business card and open the phone Add Contact screen.
Download a vCard or show a QR code of the same contact.
